workflows: Submit profile, verify applicable email/documents, review, approve/reject/more-info, resubmit as a new request.
Select book/slot, submit Pending, approve, verify reader and hand over, record Borrowed.
Return, inspect, calculate overdue or open lost/damaged incident, assess/settle compensation, update copy.
View fine, choose online or cash, reconcile webhook, verify final fine/payment state.
Create/update book, cover/location, intake copies, verify discovery and availability.
Queue unavailable title, allocate/expire hold; request and process renewal subject to policy.
Submit support, reply, verify participant history; publish announcement and verify reader view.
Configure policy/users, assign/generate/review/export report and validate totals.
Submit natural-language query, retrieve catalog sources, return relevance and graceful fallback.

nfr.protocol: HTTP loopback Kestrel; no TLS; same process load generator
nfr.method: Closed-loop fixed 1200 requests per level; max in-flight 1/10/50/100; 1:1:1 endpoint mix; one run; no think time
nfr.limitations: Synthetic small catalog; test auth; mocked providers; no AI/browser; not 100 independent user journeys; not production capacity certification
